summary: Applies mathematical functions to TOP color channels, with per-channel function selection and invalid-value replacement.

key_params.name: funcrgba
key_params.note: Function applied to all RGBA channels

key_params.name: angunit
key_params.note: Angle units: deg, rad, or cycle

key_params.name: errval
key_params.note: Replacement value for invalid math results

common_gotchas: Rerange affects integer texture formats, not float formats.
Trig functions depend on Angle Unit, so degrees/radians/cycles must match the source data.
Logs and dB conversions error on non-positive values unless replacement is handled.
Second-input functions such as atan2 and powxy require valid paired input data.
key_concepts: Function TOP applies math functions to TOP color values.
Functions can be applied to RGBA together, RGB together, or individual channels.
Some functions use Base Value, Exponent Value, or Constant Value parameters.
Some functions use a second input as an operand, such as atan2 or powxy workflows.
Angle Unit controls trig input interpretation for degree, radian, or cycle units.
Replace and Error Value handle invalid math cases such as logs and powers outside valid domains.
